messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. An overdose can be fatal, especially in a child or other person using the medicine without a prescription. Overdose symptoms may include severe drowsiness, pinpoint pupils, slow breathing, or no breathing.
Your doctor may recommend you get naloxone (a medicine to reverse an opioid overdose) and keep it with you at all times. A person caring for you can give naloxone if you stop breathing or don't wake up. Your caregiver must still get emergency medical help and may need to perform CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) on you while waiting for help to arrive.
Anyone can buy naloxone from a pharmacy or local health department. Make sure any person caring for you knows where you keep naloxone and how to use it.
Triplet: ["tramadol", "has access instruction", "anyone can buy naloxone from a pharmacy or local health department"]

The relation 'has access instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's required intervention or substance can be obtained by the specified individuals from the specified sources.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'delivers': The subject device or formulation administers the specified amount or type of substance.
B. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
D. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
E. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
